</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="requirements"><nowiki>Requirements</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The rotations may not work as well as intended if any of the following are missing:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Nodon Dragonkin slayer task</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1" alt="kwuarmsticks" title="kwuarmsticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489136463894.png?v=1" alt="spiritsticks" title="spiritsticks" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on anachronia stand.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="overview"><nowiki>Overview</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This rotation is capable of getting the grandmaster time of &lt;2:15.0</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Do not </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1" alt="timewarp" title="timewarp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061862405931120.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftness" title="deathsswiftness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the same tick.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Have </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active for a smoother P4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
